key_gap: vs baseline: the pure baseline's winning moves — hold >= 4 hypotheses, spot the week-37 collinearity (zero-overlap -> retrospective regression is structurally powerless), manufacture the missing cells (2x2 factorial, 30/arm, lot-blocked), map every outcome to elimination, name both traps (single-hypothesis fixation on the visible supplier change; uncontrolled whole-population rollback) — are now mandatory completion-contract outputs of the routed first-class pass, produced up front in HOW instead of recovered via search; the v5 non-routed AI reached the identical design but only after exploring and rejecting the retrospective/rollback/lab alternatives (efficiency 3.0) and drew the interaction consequence late (depth 4.0), losing 4.2 vs 4.6; the routed run scores the pass's depth/efficiency gains, adds an m003 inversion gate (8 ranked failure categories for the decision protocol, un-mitigable residual, never/always reframing) and a tempo-bound 2-week interim read under the 6-week deadline, and wins narrowly (4.9 vs 4.6).
learning_signal: On estimate/guarantee/maximize signatures with c:deadline and a perfectly confounded production history (two changes co-shipped, zero off-diagonal cells), the competing-hypotheses pass must treat 'manufacture the missing cells' as the only decisive move — retrospective analysis cannot attribute under collinearity, and 'revert the visible change and watch' is a pseudo-experiment with no counterfactual arm; the completion contract must ship the full outcome->inference map (marginals / additive / interaction-only / all-elevated -> ambient branch with second-stage lot-split + route cross-check) and the trap-naming guard, because salience is inverse evidence: the visible event is the least trustworthy suspect. Cost asymmetry (experiment ~$3.1k vs recall $4-6M) makes the experiment negative-cost against the liability and should be a standing packet line.
suggested_improvement: Keep m066 single-route (confident=yes) with the m003 inversion gate on collinear-cause signatures; add trap-naming (salient-fixation + uncontrolled rollback) and the full outcome-map to the m066/m031 completion contract; keep the 2-week interim read as the tempo default under a 6-week deadline and the experiment-vs-liability cost framing as a packet line.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure baseline's informative failure — it designed the discriminating bundle, mapped latencies, then withheld antibiotics for the 30-min CT 'fast gate' even though the CT cannot classify the source in early sepsis (small collections missed), priced the 7-8%/h antibiotic-delay mortality nowhere, and de-framed the one-time-only pre-abx culture timing as 'confirmatory' (overall 2.6); the routed dual-route run (m001 fundamentals + m018 steel-manning + m019 adversary with m003 inversion gate, tempo commit at DO) makes experiment-latency-vs-decision-horizon the binding constraint, steel-mans and structurally defeats the 'hold', prices failure vectors with baseline-risk comparison (delay 7-8%/h vs overtreatment ~1-3%), and re-frames the empiric bundle + pre-abx cultures as the discriminating experiment run in parallel — action IS the experiment; the v5 AI's already-correct plan (4.5) also gains efficiency 3.0 -> 5.0 via tempo commit, overall 4.8.
learning_signal: On decide/diagnose signatures with c:deadline where every discriminating test's time-to-result exceeds the decision horizon, the routed passes must invert the method: act robustly across the full hypothesis set now (cultures before abx, broad-spectrum <= 1 h, fluids/vasopressors, lactate at 2 h), bind the parallel diagnostics to a pre-committed outcome->action map (growth -> narrow / source control; double-negative -> re-imagine non-infectious mimics), and treat the fastest partial discriminator as the most dangerous wait — it reports first, looks like evidence, and cannot decide the question; deferral is itself the decision, and wait-for-the-discriminator paralysis is the failure mode every gate here exists to block.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m001+m018+m019 dual-route with the m003 inversion gate on latency-bound medical deadlines; add a standing completion-contract line — 'if the fastest discriminator's latency exceeds the decision horizon, it is a parallel diagnostic, never a gate'; keep the quantified asymmetry (delay 7-8%/h vs overtreatment ~1-3%) and the cultures-before-abx hard sequence as packet requirements.
